tara (design): Quick flag 1: mobile dashboard: metrics table horizontal scrolling conflicts with left-sidebar swipe. Figma frames + short vid here: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx. Observed on narrow phones and a foldable.
sanjay: Repro on Pixel 4a and iPhone 8. If you try to scroll a wide table row it opens the sidebar instead. Pretty annoying for quick metric scans. :confused:
leo (frontend): Root cause: global edge-swipe handler registered at doc level. Options: 1) narrow the swipe zone to 20px, 2) add a visible grab-handle (24px) that toggles the sidebar, 3) detect horizontal scroll intent in table and suppress swipe. 3 needs deltaX/deltaY heuristics but works well.
tara (design): I like the handle visually. Also UX copy: when metric names wrap, units get lost. Consider putting unit on a muted second line so a two-line wrap keeps context.
maria g.: Good call. Also suggest collapsing action buttons into a single kebab overflow on <360px; keeps rows readable. We should preserve keyboard access to the kebab.
leo (frontend): Implementation notes: add `touch-action: pan-y` on table container, use `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch`. For name wrap: `display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; overflow: hidden;` For actions: move buttons into `button.kebab` on small breakpoints and ensure `aria-label="Row actions"`.
tara (design): Accessibility nits: when overlay sidebar opens set `aria-hidden=true` on main content, trap focus inside sidebar, and use `aria-live="polite"` to announce "Sidebar opened". Kebab menu must have clear labels and focus styles.
sanjay: Also propose adjusting breakpoint where sidebar becomes overlay (currently at 720px). For dashboards that want more horizontal space, maybe keep it docked until 560px. That reduces accidental overlays on phablets.
maria g.: Can we do progressive enhancement: implement small handle + default to narrower overlay breakpoint? That seems safest.
mobile-bot: Reminder: mobile UX crit Friday 10:30am 1  Bring updated Figma frames and interaction gifs.
leo (frontend): I'll open a small PR with two patches: 1) swipe-zone handle + JS heuristic, 2) two-line metric name + kebab overflow on <360px. Will attach test recordings.
sanjay: I'll run QA on a matrix: iOS12/13 Safari, Chrome Android, Pixel Fold portrait.
tara (design): Please include short gifs showing scroll vs swipe so we can validate timings.
maria g.: Thanks. Hold canary until we confirm on the physical device matrix.
